description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Nasus''' unleashes a spirit fire at the target location, granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area for 2.5 seconds and, after a 0.264 seconds delay, dealing magic damage to enemies within.
description.text: Active: Nasus unleashes a spirit fire at the target location, granting sight of the area for 2.5 seconds and, after a 0.264 seconds delay, dealing magic damage to enemies within.

description2.raw: The fire then remains for 5 seconds, dealing magic damage each second to enemies within and inflicting them with [[File:Armor penetration icon.svg|15px|link=Armor penetration]] armor reduction, lingering for 1 second.
